annotations.title: Stage Visa CE 3.0 Stripe Dispute Evidence Draft

description: Evaluate Visa Compelling Evidence 3.0 (CE 3.0) qualification across 120-to-365-day historical charges (requiring at least 2 settled, non-refunded, non-disputed prior transactions sharing IP address, device fingerprint, or billing email) and assemble a non-destructive Stripe dispute evidence draft with submit hardcoded to false. Executes as a pure read-only staging computation that never auto-submits to card networks. Returns structuredContent containing ok, mode, statelessEphemeralAudit, tenantId, submitForcedFalse, ce3Qualification, and drawer (including stripeUpdateParams with submit: false and merged access_activity_log). Use this tool for single-dispute CE 3.0 qualification and evidence staging; use revclamp_audit_revenue_leakage for portfolio-wide dispute readiness counts.

customerId.description: Stripe customer identifier associated with the disputed charge (format example: 'cus_enterprise_88', default: 'cus_mcp_enterprise_01', max 64 chars).

demo.description: Optional simulation flag (boolean) to stage a labeled sample dispute preview.

disputeId.description: Stripe dispute identifier being staged (format example: 'du_1QxyzEnterpriseDispute01', default: 'du_mcp_staged_01', max 64 chars).

disputeReason.description: Stripe dispute reason code (e.g. 'fraudulent', 'unrecognized', 'subscription_canceled', 'product_unacceptable', 'general'; default: 'fraudulent'; Visa CE 3.0 applies to 'fraudulent' disputes).

disputedTransaction.description: Optional disputed charge snapshot object containing id (e.g. 'ch_disputed_01'), occurredAtSec (Unix seconds), customer_id, email, ip_address, and device_id.

existingAccessActivityLog.description: Optional alias for existingUncategorizedText: existing merchant evidence notes in Stripe evidence.access_activity_log (up to 18,000 chars) to preserve via append-only merge.

existingUncategorizedText.description: Optional existing merchant evidence notes in Stripe evidence.uncategorized_text or access_activity_log (up to 18,000 chars) to preserve via append-only merge without overwriting.

priorTransactions.description: Optional array of up to 1000 historical Stripe charge objects (each with id, status: 'succeeded', disputed: false, refunded: false, occurredAtSec 120-365 days prior to disputedTransaction, email, ip_address, and device_id).

usageEvents.description: Optional array of up to 200 customer product/API usage telemetry events (each with occurredAtSec Unix seconds, stripe_customer_id, and event_name) for append-only access_activity_log staging.
